8639: Stack Trace view freezes the UI when Show Duration is enabled

With Show Duration enabled, each cell summed the durations of every item
in its frame and of the root fork on the UI thread, for every row on
every refresh. Cache the summed durations per item array and compute the
root total and the initially visible frames in the model preparer instead
of the UI thread.

Also apply the persisted Show Duration state to its own action instead of
the Tree View action, release the cached durations when the model is
rebuilt, and avoid an NPE when no item has a duration.
